name: Design Futures
description: This course introduces a structured approach to envisioning, constructing and critiquing alternative futures using speculative design and design fiction, with a focus on emerging technologies and societal trends. Through a practice-based approach, students will experience various stages of the speculative design process learning to convert abstract future visions into experiential prototypes culminating into an exhibition. Topics include: speculative design, design fiction, mapping trends, world-building, experiential prototyping, etc.
